summary: Phase4 is release-ready for source handoff after passing automated checks, rebuilding web assets, and smoke-testing the packaged UI.
install_and_run: Run ./build.sh to prepare and open the local web UI
Use ./build.sh --smoke for a no-browser health/static UI check
configuration: Provider credentials remain configured through the LLM settings modal or existing auth CLI
APPFORGE_LLM_BRIDGE_URL continues to point the web app at the local bridge
No new Phase4 environment variable is required
migrations: Clients using /providers/models should migrate to /providers?include_models=true or /providers/{id}/models
No data migration is required for provider credentials or active model config

release_checks.evidence: bun run typecheck and bun test passed
npm run build generated current hashed assets
pytest passed 78 tests and ruff passed
Payload probe showed compact provider response; build.sh --smoke served health and UI

known_issues: No live credentialed LLM provider call was run
No browser screenshot automation was captured
rollback: Revert Phase4 source changes and rebuild frontend assets
Restore /providers/models route only if downstream compatibility requires it
